messages:
Zoe (docs): Hey team — my PR #4820 is blocked by the deploy preview. Linkcheck + an example that still uses `timeout_ms`. CI logs: https://deploy.example/4820/logs. @Arun can you confirm the authoritative server timeout and any Dedicated/backcompat exceptions?

merge-bot: Deploy preview 4820 — build failed. Linkcheck error: broken anchor /api/streaming#timeouts (HTML 404). Example test failed: streaming-snippets.test.js

Arun (runtime): Short answer: hosted streams default to 120s (2 minutes). We removed the client `timeout_ms` parameter in SDK v1.3. There is no public server-side client param to change that default; Dedicated new pools default to 120s as well, but some legacy Dedicated pools still enforce 60s until migrated.

Zoe (docs): OK thanks. The PR text currently says "server timeout: 60s" and the snippet is `client.generate({ model: 'rwd-small', prompt, timeout_ms: 30000 })`  so definitely needs updating.

Felix (sdk): Confirming: SDK accepted `timeout_ms` up through v1.2.x. In v1.3 we removed it and in v1.4 we added `client.withTimeout(ms, fn)`; the recommended pattern is AbortController/AbortSignal. Please pin examples to `@redwood/sdk@1.5.6` (or later) to avoid confusion.

Pri (platform): Also note the anchor probably moved to `#streaming-timeouts` in the docs site nav. Add a short backcompat callout: "Hosted default 120s; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s contact support/SE for migrations." Keeps customers from being surprised.

Zoe (docs): Plan: 1) replace the `timeout_ms` snippet with an AbortController example and an optional `client.withTimeout` snippet (JS + a one-line Python cancel example), 2) pin codeblocks to @redwood/sdk@1.5.6, 3) add the backcompat callout from Pri, 4) update the broken anchor to `#streaming-timeouts`. @Kai can you review the PR after I push?

Kai (docs-reviewer): Yep, I can review. Two quick nits to consider: show a tiny `console.log(res.routingDecision)` line so users can debug why a stream ended, and mention `allow_fallback_model_family` as an opt-in behavior that can affect fallback routing. Otherwise short and actionable is best.

Zoe (docs): Good calls  will add both. Pushing changes in ~30m.

merge-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4821.

Kai (docs-reviewer): Ping me when 4821 passes and I'll give it a final signoff.

merge-bot: Deploy preview 4821 success. Linkcheck fixed, example tests passed.

Kai (docs-reviewer): Quick pass done. LGTM from docs side. Small nit in the JS comment which I fixed in the branch; approving now.

Zoe (docs): Merged. Thanks everyone leaving a follow-up issue to sweep legacy snippets across the docs site. :tada:
